summary: This plugin adds a Code mode view in DeepSeek Harness, opening and displaying a terminal panel in the same session workspace so users can work in a command-line environment there.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is a user-facing DeepSeek Harness mode extension that adds a third UI segment called Code, placing a live terminal as the main conversation column. Evidence shows it mainly embeds and hosts `omdsh-tui` via a websocket (`/omdsh-codemode/terminal`) in the active workspace context, reusing conversation session IDs for resume/reconnect behavior rather than reimplementing terminal functionality. It is primarily a terminal + workspace workflow integration plugin with session/sidebar coordination features.
